product_description:
Speakout A2 Workbook With Key (3rd Edition)

The Workbook provides additional practice of material covered in the eight units of the Students’ Book, including:

  • Additional grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation, and functional language practice activities
  • Additional reading, writing, listening, and speaking practice activities
  • Benchmark Test task types
  • An answer key at the back of the book to allow learners to check their answers.

Note: The Workbook provides print versions of the Online Practice activities. Audio is available online using the access code inside the Student’s Book of the same level.
